narr: Scattered thunderstorms in advance of a frontal boundary produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of eastern Virginia.
ev: Flash flooding was reported on Hudgins Farm Road. Water was about one foot deep.
All lanes were closed on Route 607 in King William County in the vicinity of Upshaw Road due to flash flooding.
